title: CDFD Part I: Fundamental Physics - Constraint-Driven Field Theory and Flux Dynamics
description: Public Part I physics archive for the Constraint-Driven Field Theory / Constraint-Driven Flux Dynamics project. The release includes manuscripts, compiled PDFs, LaTeX sources, supplementary Python scripts, generated figures and checks, bibliography, claim-status notes, reproducibility instructions, and a minimal public demo. The archive is released as open preprint material with reproducible calculations; it is not peer reviewed and does not by itself establish empirical validation of the physical hypotheses.
